governed_tradeoff_rule.acceptance: A small metric degradation may be accepted only when every binding absolute and PyBDSF non-inferiority gate remains satisfied, another scientifically related metric improves materially, and the complete change is explained and documented.
governed_tradeoff_rule.incumbent_role: The incumbent remains a binding regression comparator and every movement is reported, but a Pareto-improving or explicitly reviewed scientifically favourable trade-off is not rejected solely because one incumbent-relative point estimate moves slightly.
governed_tradeoff_rule.prohibitions: No threshold, practical margin, comparator, gate, or confidence rule may change after observing candidate results.
